history.value: Cherry Ventures was founded in Berlin in 2012 by Filip Dames and Christian Meermann, who had helped build Zalando, first as an angel fund backing AUTO1, FlixBus and Quandoo. It grew into a pan-European seed firm with teams in Berlin, London and Stockholm, backing Forto, Flink and Moss. In 2025 it raised $500M for its fifth fund and an opportunity fund.
history.basis: the About page (angel fund 2012, Cherry II EUR 150M 2016, III EUR 175M 2019, IV EUR 320M 2022, V $500M 2025; teams in Berlin, London, Stockholm); founders' Zalando past per their profile pages; AUTO1/FlixBus/Amorelie/Quandoo as 2012-2013 entries per the archived listings' investment dates; the named later companies are ledger-verified members. Rewritten to the reader-facing shape (PRO-147, 2026-09-24). The old thesis was the site's tagline ('Founders first. For companies that last.'); the rewrite states what the firm backs, per investment_stage, investment_geo and investment_scope.

investment_concept.value: Founders first. For companies that last.
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from its homepage headline (h1, set in capitals by the site's styling) and title tag, read 2026-09-26; sentence case, straight quotes and a closing period are the only edits. PRO-147: the thesis is the firm's own crisp statement (Erik, 2026-09-26).

investment_stage.basis: the About page: 'early-stage investors, from pre-seed to Series A', seed as the core stage; the 2025 opportunity fund backs portfolio companies 'at Series B and beyond' (Cherry V announcement, TechCrunch 2025-02-05) -> Growth; the landed base: Seed 113 / Pre-Seed 22 / Series A 11 / Growth 2 of 148

investment_geo.basis: the About page ('pan-European, not country-focused'; offices Berlin, London, Stockholm; a San Francisco venture partner); the base: 87 DE rows, 18 GB, 8 SE, 6 DK, 12 US of 148 -> core Europe, other US (two-label cap respected; no §9 trigger 3)

investment_scope.basis: focus from the firm's own site sector tags on 265 base rows, crosswalked to data/taxonomy/focus.json (crosswalk in config.json), published above 7 companies. Scope type is the curated judgement carried in investor.json.

investment_range.basis: lower: the firm's own FAQ ('typically we invest between EUR 2 million and EUR 7 million'), with documented EUR 1M pre-seeds (Bits) as the floor; median: press-based — the median of 51 documented entry rounds of verified members 2013-2026 (the firm's own posts and cited press; scratch/verified-median.json), $5.0M, the late Growth/Series A entries and the SellerX equity-plus-debt seed excluded as outliers — not a filing-grade Form D distribution; upper: the largest led or co-led rounds (Dash0 $35M Series A co-led, Qlub $30M co-led, Proxima Fusion EUR 130M Series A co-led with Balderton) capped at a 10% single-position concentration of the $500M Cherry V

notable_investments.basis: recognition over the confirmed base only (COLLECTION.md §11): eight ledger-verified members the model recognises — Flix, AUTO1 (public), Forto, Moss, Flink, Infarm, Amorelie, Quandoo

aum.basis: bottom: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of Cherry Ventures Management GmbH (AIFM), CRD 301494, annual amendment 2024-03-14 (IAPD PDF parsed 2026-09-04, scratch/adv-7b-funds.json): Cherry Ventures Fund III GmbH & Co. KG $534,198,960, Fund IV GmbH & Co. KG $342,626,794, Cherry Decentral I $28,890,469 = $905,716,223 — an ERA-only firm files no Item 5.F RAUM, so 7.B is the sworn substitute; it predates Cherry V ($500M, 2025) and Select V and omits Fund II and the Opportunities vehicles, so it is a floor; top: press 'around $1 billion assets under management' (Private Equity International institution profile / privateequitylist, 2025), the only credible press figure; the firm publishes no AUM

funds.basis: the firm's own About page fund ladder (2012 angel fund, Cherry II EUR 150M, III EUR 175M, IV EUR 320M, V $500M) with sizes converted at ECB reference rates on the announcement dates (scripts/fx-convert.py, D9): IV EUR 320M @ ECB 2022-01-20 (announced as EUR 300M on 2022-01-20 — own post, TechCrunch's contemporaneous $312M — and stated as EUR 320M by the site after the final close) = $362,800,000; III EUR 175M @ ECB 2019-06-19 (own post 'say hello to our Fund III', TechCrunch 2019-06-19) = $196,100,000; II EUR 150M @ ECB 2016-05-24 (the TourRadar release: 'first investment since announcing the closing of its new EUR 150 million fund') = $167,500,000; V $500M (own 2025 open letter; TechCrunch 2025-02-05) split between the Early Stage fund and an opportunity fund; Cherry Decentral I at its Form D amount sold ($17,120,721, accession-verified). The 2012 angel fund (Cherry Ventures UG & Co. KG) has no published size and is described, not listed; the US feeders (Fund III (US) / IV (US) L.P., $200.7M / $311.0M offerings, $0 sold at filing), the Growth Fund (2021), Select V (2024) and the Opportunities II-XII co-investment KGs are vehicles of the same funds or unsized sleeves (D1, D6) and are not listed

hq_location.basis: Principal office on the newest Form ADV: Linienstrabe 214, Berlin, Germany (CHERRY VENTURES MANAGEMENT GMBH (AIFM), CRD 301494, Annual Amendment filed 2024-03-14). The firm's site lists Berlin, Germany; London, United Kingdom; Stockholm, Sweden; the principal office is among them, so the site agrees. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
